# Report — macro engine + one-shot hotkey removal

**Plan:** [`20260804-204216_macro-engine-onshot-removal.plan.qmd`](20260804-204216_macro-engine-onshot-removal.plan.qmd)
· **Status:** complete · **Head:** `bc795d5`

## Bottom line

Two workstreams shipped and verified on Windows:

1. **Removed the `Ctrl+Shift+,` one-shot hotkey** (hotkey only; `OneClick` mode + the
   press-again toggle kept).
2. **Macro engine in hap**: `Ctrl+Shift;` opens a topmost palette; type a macro's
   single-char key to run its steps. Macros live in `%APPDATA%\hap\macros.json`
   (personal, not in git; re-read each open). The user's "create lark task" macro runs
   via `focusWindow Feishu` → `clickAbs(38,340)` → `send Ctrl+N`.

**B2 (overlay-driven targeting) and B3 (recording) were descoped** — `clickAbs` covers
fixed-target macros more robustly than labels, so they are not needed for the stated goal.

## Step types shipped (B1)

`send` (`Mods`+`Key`), `wait` (`Ms`), `focusWindow` (`Title`,`Match`=`exact`|`contains`,
aborts on 0/>1 match, preserves maximized state), `clickAbs` (`X`,`Y` physical screen px),
`clickRel` (`Dx`,`Dy` from the focused window rect), `rawReplay` (declared; recorder not
built). `openOverlay`/`overlayType`/`nudge` are in the schema but throw NotImplemented.

## Notable lessons

Five bugs were caught (3 by CI, 2 by the Windows test) and fixed — recorded in the plan's
"Bugs found and fixed" table. Two general lessons: (1) on a repo with no local build, grep
the **method name** across all call sites when removing a parameter; (2) xUnit 2.2.0's
`xunit.assert` targets netstandard1.1, so `Assert.Throws` pulls in the `Task` facade the
net452 test project doesn't reference — use try/catch over `Action` in this test project.

## Deployed drops (Windows test box, under `HAP_WIN_TEST_DIR`)

`hap-oneshot-rm` (A), `hap-macros-b1` / `hap-macros-fix1` / `hap-macros-fix2` /
`hap-macros-fix3` (B1 + runtime fixes). Latest = `hap-macros-fix3` (`bc795d5`).
